subject: Quote-aware redirect detection in orch-gate-bash.sh
description:
Fix false-positive write detection in hooks/orch-gate-bash.sh where literal redirect chars (> <) inside quoted arguments trip the redirect regex, blocking read-only commands like `find . -name '*[<>:\"|?*]*'` (Windows-forbidden-char search) and similar grep/find calls.

FIX: Before running ONLY the two redirect-detection regexes (currently lines 56 and 59 operating on $CMD), compute a quote-masked copy of the command that replaces single- and double-quoted spans with a placeholder token, e.g.:

  CMD_REDIR=$(printf '%s' "$CMD" | sed "s/'[^']*'/Q/g; s/\"[^\"]*\"/Q/g")

Then run the two redirect grep checks (lines 56, 59) against $CMD_REDIR instead of $CMD. Leave ALL other write-pattern checks (tee, python/ruby open/.write, cp/mv/rsync/install, dd of=, sed -i) operating on the original $CMD unchanged — masking must apply to redirect detection ONLY.

WHY the placeholder (Q) and not deletion: a real redirect to a quoted filename `echo x > \"file\"` must STILL be detected. Masking the quoted span to `Q` keeps a non-slash/non-space/non-& char after the `>` so regex line 56 still fires; deleting the span would create a false-negative (bypass). Verify both: (a) `find . -name '*[<>]*'` no longer trips WRITE_PATTERN, and (b) `echo x > \"file\"` and `cmd > out.txt` still DO. Also confirm the target-extraction logic below (TARGETS loop) is unaffected — it already operates on CMD_NOCOMMENT, leave it.

Keep the change surgical: ~2-3 lines added, the two grep invocations repointed. Match existing shell style and comment density. Add a one-line comment explaining the masking. This is a security gate — no scope creep beyond the redirect false-positive.

TEST (no formal suite for this hook): manually pipe representative JSON inputs through the script or extract the regex logic and assert on the cases above. At minimum document the manual verification in the complete_task summary.

summary:
Fixed false-positive redirect detection in hooks/orch-gate-bash.sh.

CHANGE: hooks/orch-gate-bash.sh lines 53–66 (worktree orch/attempt/df48eca4-5e3f-4f70-aae8-0a21d3a6ec50-1). Added 4 lines + repointed 2 grep invocations:
- Added CMD_REDIR variable computed by masking single- and double-quoted spans to 'Q' via sed
- Changed both redirect-detection greps (first: (^|[^[:alnum:]._@-])(>>?)\s*[^/\s&0-9], second: (>>?)\s*/(?!(dev/null))) to read from $CMD_REDIR instead of $CMD
- All other write-pattern checks (tee, python open/.write, cp/mv/rsync/install, dd of=, sed -i) remain on $CMD unchanged
- TARGETS extraction loop (CMD_NOCOMMENT) untouched

VERIFICATION (verify-fix.sh, committed alongside the fix):
(a) CMD='find . -name '*[<>:"|?*]*''  -> CMD_REDIR='find . -name Q'  -> WRITE_PATTERN=0  PASS (false-positive fixed)
(b) CMD='echo x > "file"'              -> CMD_REDIR='echo x > Q'      -> WRITE_PATTERN=1  PASS (no new bypass)
(c) CMD='cmd > out.txt'                -> CMD_REDIR='cmd > out.txt'    -> WRITE_PATTERN=1  PASS
(d) CMD='grep -rE ''a|b'' .'          -> CMD_REDIR='grep -rE Q .'     -> WRITE_PATTERN=0  PASS

All 4 cases pass. Commit: 98591c0 on orch/attempt/df48eca4-5e3f-4f70-aae8-0a21d3a6ec50-1.
